scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Analytical theorem for strictly positive binary homogeneous order-two kernels only. The full-history marginal-target observable uses strictly positive first hitting times; its first-order direction follows from the classical random-target lemma. Nonpositive boundaries, larger state spaces and higher orders are not classified. Exact finite computations corroborate, but do not replace, the analytical argument. Historical priority and independent validation remain unverified.
title: Sharp quadratic memory gaps for binary second-order random-target hitting times
